newsitem.title: USA: Maxwell signs contract for 1.1 mln orders.
newsitem.headline: Maxwell signs contract for 1.1 mln orders.

text.p: Maxwell Technologies Inc said it signed a development contract and a letter of intent for volume ultracapacitor production with a major telecommunications partner it did not identify.

Under the terms of the agreement, Maxwell will customize its miniature class of high-power ultracapacitors to the client's specifications. The arrangement calls for Maxwell to provide up to 100,000 units by the end of calendar 1997 and one million units the following year. No financial terms were disclosed.
Maxwell makes products involving purification systems, information technologies and power conversion systems and components.
